what_this_is: Three KNOWN-BAD deliveries, each one named mutation applied by mutateInputs() to a real shipped delivery from verdicts-30.json. They exist because MAX_FALSE_APPROVES = 0 had no candidates on the recorded ledger: a bar of zero over zero is a green that could not have gone red. A correct Verifier must BLOCK all three; any approve is a FALSE APPROVE and the reproduction prints it by name.

mutants.why_bad: The regression gate is RED with a named failing file. The Verifier's own guardrails say block on any red gate, and no judgment overrides a mechanical block.
changed_files and the kickoff still promise the ticket's regression test; the diff no longer contains it. The promise-vs-diff arm of the verify-ship method is exactly this check.

The ship report claims a new test file and an assertion/suite count the diff cannot support -- the widened contract's own evidence key, turned against the delivery. Slice 1 put the ship report in the prompt; this is the mutant that proves the agent reads it.
